test_title: PYST 16: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: Initial value of a car is Rs. 150000. The value of car depreciated by 20 percent of its initial value each year. What will be its value after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial value of the car = Rs. 150000

Depreciation rate = 20%

Time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Depreciation value after n years = Initial value × (1 - Depreciation rate)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Depreciation rate = 20% = 0.20

After 1 year:

Value after 1 year = 150000 × (1 - 0.20)

⇒ 150000 × 0.80

⇒ 120000

After 2 years:

Value after 2 years = 120000 × (1 - 0.20)

⇒ 120000 × 0.80

⇒ 96000

**The value of the car after 2 years will be Rs. 96000.**
